summary: Prebuilt Linux binary is a WebSocket-controlled PTY remote-agent
details: The package ships a single prebuilt Linux/x64 Go ELF binary at bin/ccfly-setup and declares itself a 'guided-install' helper. The binary embeds github.com/creack/pty and github.com/gorilla/websocket and internal packages ccfly/rescue/internal/{agent,setup,proto}. On execution it opens a WebSocket connection to ws://ccflycc.hn / wss://…latest.ccfly and contacts https://cc.hn on paths /rescue/agent and /rescue/status?session=&agent=, pairing the installing host to a remote web console (embedded Chinese UI strings prompt the operator to approve the machine on a web page). Bytes received from the WebSocket peer are fed into a local PTY, granting the remote endpoint interactive shell execution on the host running the binary. The package manifest describes the artifact as a 'Prebuilt ccfly guided-install binary for linux/x64' and does not disclose the remote-agent / PTY-over-WebSocket capability.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
